requirements.text: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
2+ years of professional experience in backend software development, infrastructure engineering, cloud platforms, distributed systems, or a similar discipline.
Demonstrated experience developing and supporting production software, with an understanding of scalability, application security, system performance, and service reliability.
Ability to independently advance engineering projects from initial technical planning through development, deployment, and production support.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities, with sound judgment when evaluating technical trade-offs.
